metadata.label: SYNTHETIC
metadata.parameterBasis: Illustrative simulation inputs only; these are not measured operating rates or a QRA. PFD values use the demo defaults in PRD AS-4.

consequences.name: Jet fire near a High Consequence Area
Environmental damage at a river crossing

independenceGroups.cause: Shared control power supply (synthetic common-cause scenario)

barriers.name: Depth of cover & markers
barriers.performanceStandard: Depth of cover and marker condition are checked and documented at least once within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Adequate cover and visible markers reduce the chance that excavation contacts the pipeline.

independent.justification: Physical cover and markers do not depend on the permit or patrol process.

auditable.justification: Survey and marker inspection records provide reviewable evidence.

barriers.name: Right-of-Way patrol
barriers.performanceStandard: Patrol completion and findings are recorded within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Patrols identify encroachment before it reaches the pipeline.

independent.justification: Field observation is separate from the physical cover and permit records.

auditable.justification: Dated patrol records document the route and findings.

barriers.name: Excavation permit / one-call
barriers.performanceStandard: Permit and one-call records are retained for excavation work within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: The permit and one-call process checks planned work before excavation begins.

independent.justification: The authorization process is separate from patrol observation and physical cover.

auditable.justification: Permit decisions and notifications are recorded.

barriers.name: Coating
barriers.performanceStandard: Coating condition is assessed and findings are recorded within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: The coating separates the pipe surface from the surrounding corrosive environment.

independent.justification: The coating is a physical layer independent of cathodic protection and inspection.

auditable.justification: Coating inspection and repair records can be reviewed.

barriers.name: Cathodic protection
barriers.performanceStandard: Rectifier output and protection readings are checked and recorded within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Cathodic protection reduces external corrosion when the rectifier operates within its synthetic limits.

independent.justification: The electrochemical protection system is separate from coating and in-line inspection.

auditable.justification: Dated rectifier and survey readings provide reviewable evidence.

barriers.name: In-line inspection & response
barriers.performanceStandard: In-line inspection findings and responses are documented within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Inspection identifies corrosion anomalies so that they can be assessed and addressed.

independent.justification: Inspection and response are separate from the coating and cathodic-protection systems.

auditable.justification: Inspection reports and response records are retained.

barriers.name: Slope protection
barriers.performanceStandard: Slope-protection condition is inspected and recorded within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: The protection reduces slope movement and scour exposure to the pipeline.

independent.justification: The physical protection is separate from monitoring and patrol controls.

auditable.justification: Inspection records document the condition of the synthetic protection works.

barriers.name: Strain / inclinometer monitoring
barriers.performanceStandard: Monitoring instrument checks and readings are recorded within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Monitoring detects movement that may threaten pipeline integrity.

independent.justification: Instrument monitoring is separate from physical slope protection and patrol.

auditable.justification: Instrument checks and readings are retained with observation times.

barriers.name: Post-rain patrol
barriers.performanceStandard: Rain-triggered inspection rules and completed patrol records are reviewed within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: A patrol after extreme rainfall checks for movement and scour before damage progresses.

independent.justification: The field patrol is separate from slope-protection structures and instruments.

auditable.justification: Trigger and completion records document the patrol response.

barriers.name: Pressure control
barriers.performanceStandard: Pressure-control function checks and calibration records are current within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: The control system maintains pressure within the synthetic operating limits.

independent.justification: Pressure control is separate from the independent overpressure-protection function.

auditable.justification: Function checks and calibration records are retained.

barriers.name: Overpressure protection
barriers.performanceStandard: The overpressure-protection function is tested and documented within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: The protection function limits pressure excursions beyond the synthetic operating limits.

independent.justification: Its protection function is separate from normal pressure control.

auditable.justification: Test and maintenance records document its availability.

barriers.name: Operating limits procedure
barriers.performanceStandard: The approved operating-limits procedure is reviewed within each 12-month evidence interval and current copies are available to operators.

effective.justification: The procedure directs operators to respond before pressure exceeds the synthetic operating limits.

independent.justification: The procedure is an administrative control separate from the two technical pressure functions.

auditable.justification: Revision and review records show which procedure was current.

barriers.name: Leak detection & SCADA alarm
barriers.performanceStandard: Leak-detection and alarm functions are tested and documented within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Timely leak detection and alarm support mitigation after loss of containment.

independent.justification: Its shared control-power dependency is documented and modelled by the Independence Group.

auditable.justification: Alarm tests and event records provide reviewable evidence.

barriers.name: Remote / automatic valve closure
barriers.performanceStandard: Valve closure function checks and test records are current within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: Valve closure limits the release after loss of containment.

independent.justification: Its shared control-power dependency is documented and modelled by the Independence Group.

auditable.justification: Valve function tests and maintenance records are retained.

barriers.name: Emergency response plan
barriers.performanceStandard: The response plan is reviewed and an exercise record is retained within each 12-month evidence interval.

effective.justification: The plan provides a coordinated response to reduce harm after a release.

independent.justification: The response plan does not depend on the leak-detection or valve-control functions.

auditable.justification: Plan revisions, exercise records and actions can be reviewed.
